lines.zh: 缓慢地移动着，发出轻微的声响。
lines.en: Moves slowly, making a soft noise.

lines.zh: 轻轻拍打着地上的灰尘。
lines.en: Gently taps the ground with its feet.

lines.zh: 用手指向玩家，示意自己。
lines.en: Points at the player with its finger.

lines.zh: 观察周围的环境，保持警觉。

lines.en: Gently taps the ground with its staff.

lines.zh: 一步一响，我跟着你的脚跟。
lines.en: A sound each step, I follow your heels.

lines.zh: 宠物蛋的纹路还在我额上。
lines.en: The pet egg's pattern is still on my brow.
I walk slowly, but I never fall behind.

lines.zh: 泥土从我的关节里挤出来。
lines.en: Dirt squeezes out of my joints.

lines.zh: 静静地站立着，等待命令。
偶尔发出微弱的呢喃声。

lines.en: I wait by the door for your return.

lines.zh: 三十点生命，全用来跟着你。
lines.en: Thirty points of life, all spent following you.
I don't fight. I only follow.
The light in my palms flickers.

lines.zh: 你的影子停住，我的脚也停住。
lines.en: Your shadow stops, and so do my feet.
TURNS to look at the player.

lines.zh: 看向玩家，眼中充满关切。
lines.en: LOOKS at the player with concern in its eyes.

lines.zh: 目光中透出温暖的光芒。
lines.en: ITS eyes emit a warm light.
STARES at the player, showing trust.
LOOKS at the player, ready to cast a spell.

lines.zh: 关注着玩家的一举一动。
lines.en: PAYING attention to the player's movements.

lines.zh: 注视玩家，准备帮助他们。
lines.en: LOOKS at the player, ready to help.
Let me closer, to sniff your wound.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不亮，但它们看着你。
lines.en: My eyes don't shine, but they watch you.

lines.zh: 你走路有点歪，是腿伤吧。
lines.en: You walk a little crooked. Your leg, right?

lines.zh: 我记住你的位置了，别担心。
lines.en: I've marked where you are. Don't worry.
Whenever you look back, I'm there.

lines.zh: 我治不了自己，只能站着缓。
lines.en: I heal others. Myself, I just stand and wait.

lines.zh: 触碰我，你会感觉年轻许多！
lines.en: Touch me, and you’ll feel much younger!

lines.zh: 吃我赐予的生命之果吧！
lines.en: Eat the life fruit I offer you.

lines.zh: 我的外表虽丑，但内心强大！
lines.en: I may look ugly, but I’m strong inside.

lines.zh: 与我为伴，你会焕发新生！
lines.en: Be with me, and you’ll be rejuvenated.

lines.zh: 你吃了我的果实，会变得更健康！
lines.en: Eating my fruit will make you healthier.
I am a symbol of healing.

lines.zh: 使用宠物蛋，我能保护你！
lines.en: Use the pet egg, and I’ll protect you.

lines.zh: 你无法伤害我，我已经治愈！
lines.en: You can’t hurt me, I’m already healed.
You cannot budge this stone body.
Don’t come close, I’ll heal you.

lines.zh: 使用治愈之力，我是坚不可摧！
lines.en: Use the power of healing, I’m indestructible.

lines.zh: 你碰不到我，我已经愈合！
lines.en: You can’t touch me, I’m already healed.

lines.zh: 我的力量超越一切伤害！
使用宠物蛋，我能保护你
lines.en: Use the pet egg, and I’ll protect you
I am the light of healing.

lines.zh: 找我做伴，你会更加快乐！
lines.en: Be with me, and you’ll be happier.

lines.zh: 与我共生，共享治愈之力！
lines.en: Be with me, share the healing power.
My mate is also a healer.

lines.zh: 与我在一起，你会更健康！
lines.en: Be with me, and you’ll be healthier.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣能治愈更多人！
lines.en: My mate can heal more people.

lines.zh: 我们的力量合并更强大！
与我在一起，你会更强大！
lines.en: Be with me, and you’ll be stronger.
My mate is also a healer.

lines.zh: 与我共舞，治愈的旋律响起！
lines.en: Dance with me, the healing melody plays.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣也是生命之源！
lines.en: My mate is also the source of life.

lines.zh: 我的身体在呼唤你的抚摸。
与我一起，感受生命的奇迹。
lines.en: Feel the miracle of life with me.

lines.zh: 治愈的力量在我体内涌动。

lines.en: You give me a second life.
Your warmth drives away the cold.

lines.zh: 你走在前面，我跟着就够。
lines.en: You walk ahead. I just follow.

lines.zh: 我将追随你直到天涯海角。
lines.en: I will follow you to the ends of the earth.

lines.zh: 无论何时，我都会在你身边。
lines.en: I will be by your side whenever you need me.
Take a step and I follow.
My place is at your back left.

lines.zh: 你要去哪儿，我就去哪儿。

lines.en: My healing light shines on you.
Let me heal you with love.

lines.zh: 我的光芒将带给你希望。
lines.en: My light brings hope to you.

lines.zh: 你将被我的力量所净化。
lines.en: You will be cleansed by my power.
Let me protect you from harm.
My target is to heal you.
I press my hand to your wound.
Hold still. The light is coming.
When you hurt, I glow brighter.

lines.zh: 我治不了自己，只能治你。
lines.en: I can't heal myself. Only you.
I'll take this blow for you.
I can't block it, but I won't step back.
A body of stone can take a hit.
The shell cracks and I stand up.

lines.zh: 我的第一眼看到的是你。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was you.

lines.zh: 额上的纹路亮了，我活了。
lines.en: The pattern on my brow lit up. I was alive.
An arrow lodges in my shoulder seam.
Magic seeps into my stone seams.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的石缝都在抖。
lines.en: Lightning struck. Every seam of me shakes.

lines.zh: 我是只会跟着你的傀儡。
lines.en: I'm a golem that only wants to follow you.
